(Bt.); (2) = mūrvā (Hṛdayadīpaka 47; Ma.nigh. 1, 224; Rā.nigh. 3, 10-11; comm. on Śivakoṣa 509; Vśs; MW; PW) (cf. madhusrava above); (3) = piṇḍakharjūrī (Dha.nigh. 5, 55; Vśs; MW); (4) = madhuyaṣṭī (Dha.nigh. 1, 142; Rā.nigh. 6, 182; Nś. 189; Vśs; MW; PW); (5) = haṃsapā̆dī (on this see below) (Dha.nigh. 4, 111; Ma.nigh. 1, 259; Pa.ra. 390; Rā.nigh. 5, 165-168; Śivakoṣa 509; Vśs; MW; PW); (6) = jīvantī (Amarakośa 2, 4, 142; Bpn, guḍūcyādivarga 50; comm. on Śivakoṣa 509; Vśs; MW; PW); (7) = śatāvarī (Nś. 295cd-296); (8) = raktalajjālukā (Vśs: unidentified); (9) Wattakaka volubilis (Linn. f.) Stapf = Dregea volubilis (Linn. f.) Benth. ex Hook.f. = Hoya viridiflora R.Br. (MW; see WIRM 10, p. 564 and Chopra on the nomenclature).
महासहा: mahāsahā (1) = māṣaparṇī (Amarakośa 2, 4, 139; Bpn, guḍūcyādivarga 55; Ḍa. on Su.Sū. 38, 4 and U.42, 113; Dha.nigh. 1, 136; Dgv, nr. 116; DGV 2-3, p. 651; Hṛdayadīpaka 104; Kai.Nigh., oṣadhivarga 104cd-105; Ma.nigh. 1, 88; Na 1, nr. 131; Nadk. 1, nr. 1133; Nś. 210; Pa.ra. 115-116; Rā.nigh. 3, 170-172; Siddhasāra-Nigh. 13; Śivakoṣa 538cd; Soḍhalanigh. 1, 189cd-191ab); (2) = kubjaka (Bpn, puṣpavarga 37; Dha.nigh. 5, 146) = kubjakā (Ma. nigh. 3, 88) = vakrakaṇṭaka (comm. on Śivakoṣa 538): a) Rosa brunonii Lindl. = R. moschata Hook. f., non Mill. nec Herrm. (Bpn, puṣpavarga 37: R. moschata Herrm.; Nadk. 1, nr. 2152: R. moschata Mill. = R. pubescens = R. glandulifera; see Hooker 2, p. 367 and WIRM 9, p. 66 on the nomenclature); b) R. centifolia Linn. (KB 2, p. 981-982); (3) = jalakubjaka (Kai.Nigh., oṣadhivarga 1480): unidentified; (4) = rājataraṇī (Rā.nigh. 10, 246) = rājataruṇī (Rā.nigh., ed. Tripā-ṭhī, 10, 127): unidentified, but probably a kind of rose; (5) = amilāta (Nś. 245) = amlāta (Nś. 245) = amlāna (Amarakośa 2, 4, 74: Kai.Nigh., oṣadhivarga 1047-1048; Śivakoṣa 538) (on these see above); (6) = murā (Śivakoṣa 387); (7) Gomphrena globosa Linn. (MW; PW); (8) Holarrhena antidysenterica Wall. = Wrightia antidysenterica J. Grah. (MW).
माषपर्णी: māṣaparṇī (1) Teramnus labialis (Linn.f.) Spreng. (Bpn, guḍūcyādivarga 55; Bt.; Chopra; Dgv, nr. 116; DGV 5, p. 227-228; Dha.nigh., ed. Ojhā, 1, 136; Dha.nigh., ed. P.V. Sharma, 1, 132; Dutt; DWH 1, p. 491; Gul.; HK; Kai.Nigh., oṣadhivarga 104cd-105; Kaviratna; KB 1, p. 774-775; Na 1, nr. 131; Nadk. 1, nr. 2447; PA 1, 7, p. 66-78; Rā.nigh., ed. (PA 1, 7, p. 66); (9) Calopogonium mucunoides Desv. (PA 1, 7, p. 66).
